task_description: Add a backtesting engine to the Kraken Lua Trader that replays historical OHLC data through existing Lua trading scripts (unchanged), simulates order execution, and produces a performance report (P&L, trades, win rate, drawdown, Sharpe ratio). Invoked via --backtest CLI flag.

verification.summary: Build compiles cleanly. Backtest runs end-to-end with both simple_momentum.lua and top_crypto_trader.lua. CLI error handling validated (--balance foo prints friendly error). All 5 v1 review issues fixed. V2 review APPROVED with 3 non-blocking suggestions for future improvement.
